met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Bikaner, Banasthali Vidyapeeth, Guna, Damoh, Pendra Road, Rourkela, Digha and thence southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level titling southwards with height. The east-west shear zone now runs roughly along 23°N Lat. between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height across north peninsular India.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Central parts of north Madhya Pradesh has merged with above shear zone.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Jammu & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists with a trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining north Odisha coast between 5.8 and 7.6 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
